extracted.intended_audience: professional and student editorial cartoonists preparing award submissions (U.S. and Canadian)
extracted.subtask_description: A checklist of eligibility, deadlines, fees, prize amounts, and submission URLs for editorial/cartoon awards covering work published in 2021; intended to guide cartoonists in preparing and entering submissions for 2022 award cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pulitzer Prize — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: January 25, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Journalism entry site has reopened for the 2022 cycle; submission via entrysite.pulitzer.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pulitzer Prize — Eligibility (publication)
rubrics_metrics.description: For work published in print or online by a United States-based news organization with a regular publication schedule in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pulitzer Prize — Award criteria (selection)
rubrics_metrics.description: For a distinguished portfolio of editorial cartoons or other illustrated work (still, animated, or both) characterized by political insight, editorial effectiveness, or public service value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the qualities the entry should demonstrate (political insight, editorial effectiveness, public service value).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pulitzer Prize — Prize amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pulitzer Prize — Entry fee & payment method
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry fee: $75 per entry – paid by credit card only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Cartoon (Overseas Press Club) — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: January 31, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and entry form available online at http://www.opcofamerica.org/.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Cartoon (Overseas Press Club) — Eligibility / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual award from the Overseas Press Club of America for “best cartoon” on international affairs published during 2021 in a U.S.-based publication or for a U.S.-based audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus is international affairs cartoons published in 2021 aimed at U.S. audiences or publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Cartoon (Overseas Press Club) — Prize & recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: All award winners receive a certificate and a $1,000 prize.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Cartoon (Overseas Press Club) — Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.description: $200 entry fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Herblock Prize — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: February 1, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and entry form available online at https://www.herbblockfoundation.org/herblock-prize/entry-form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Herblock Prize — Eligibility / who may enter
rubrics_metrics.description: Open to newspaper, magazine, syndicate or wire service cartoonists for work published in 2021 in the U.S. or its territories, or in foreign editions of U.S.-based publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Herblock Prize — Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.description: No entry fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Headliner Awards — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: February 11, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and entry form available online at http://www.headlinerawards.org/entry/.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Headliner Awards — Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Headliner competition is open to all material appearing in a paid-circulation publication or broadcast in the United States in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Headliner Awards — Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry fee $75.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robert F. Kennedy Journalism Award — Deadline (timing note)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: TBA (usually the first week in February).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the RFK awards page for final deadline; rules and entry form available online at https://rfkhumanrights.org/awards/book-journalism-awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robert F. Kennedy Journalism Award — Eligibility / focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The RFK awards honor outstanding coverage of human rights and social justice issues, and the power of individual action in the United States and around the world, for work published in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robert F. Kennedy Journalism Award — Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry fee: $75.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sigma Delta Chi Award (SPJ) — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: February 7, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and entry form available online at http://www.spj.org/a-sdx.asp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sigma Delta Chi Award (SPJ) — Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The award from the Society of Professional Journalists recognizes an editorial cartoonist published in a newspaper, magazine, newsletter or on-line news site during 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sigma Delta Chi Award (SPJ) — Entry fee (member vs nonmember)
rubrics_metrics.description: $60 fee per entry for SPJ members or $100 fee for nonmembers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark of Excellence (Student Awards) — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: January 24, 20212.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and entry form available online at http://www.spj.org/a-moe.asp. (Original page contains a typographic year error.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark of Excellence (Student Awards) — Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Open to student cartoonists currently enrolled in college for work published in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark of Excellence (Student Awards) — Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.description: $20 entry fee for SPJ members, $30 for non-members.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Newspaper Awards (Canada) — Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline: January 9, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and entry form available online at http://www.nna-ccj.ca.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Newspaper Awards (Canada) — Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Open to cartoons appearing in daily Canadian newspapers (or their online editions) in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Newspaper Awards (Canada) — Entry fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry fee: $50.
